Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. National Gay Rights Advocates, Bowers versus Hardwick in United States Supreme Court 2. Two openly gay candidates run for office in Dane County, Wisconsin 3. Megatone Records manager pleads guilty to embezzling fourteen thousand dollars from Gay Men's Health crisis proceeds 4. Austin, Texas Klu Klux Klan member lashes out against homosexuals COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 5. Boston College anti-gay discrimination 6. Jack Campbell runs for Florida United States Senate COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 7. Cambridge University treats AIDS patients with HTLVIII antibody blood 8. Two labs develop possible HTLVIII vaccine advances 9. Report examines HTLVIII credibility 10. Pennsylvania bill proposes HTLVIII positive marriage ban COMMERCIAL: Commodore Plus 4 11. Sports, includes clips 12. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Doris Traussig, GMHC volunteer, discusses what she does and why she volunteers 13. screening of "A Chance of a Lifetime" at Hunter College 14. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby, includes clip COMMERCIAL: CASIO Pocket TV 3. Cable Car Awards coverage COMMERCIAL: NGTF Fund for Human Dignity with Mike Farrell 4. Sybil Bruncheon's birthday party COMMERCIAL: The Monster 5. Current events/media/culture
